verdict.rationale: Unleash documents variants for A/B testing, but nothing shows defining experiment metrics from warehouse tables or ingested events. The closest feature, impact metrics, queries external Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics data. That data drives rollout safeguards and milestone progression, which is a related but different feature, not experiment metric definition.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store
